question: Should the production exact-review admission increase to 28 global leases and 24 per-target leases land now, and should the release-owned changelog line stay in this branch?
rationale: The code path is narrow, but the exact capacity values are an operator policy choice and the branch touches release-owned CHANGELOG.md, which automation should not decide unilaterally.

options.title: Land after live-capacity confirmation
options.body: After required CI passes, merge only if maintainers still accept the 28/24 production admission values against current queue/fleet telemetry and handle the changelog intentionally.

options.title: Keep draft for more telemetry
options.body: Leave the PR open while collecting more queue age, failure-rate, and cross-repository reservation data before changing production admission.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Revise the branch to remove the release-owned changelog edit or choose a smaller cap if maintainers want a more conservative rollout.

recommendation.title: Land after live-capacity confirmation
recommendation.body: After required CI passes, merge only if maintainers still accept the 28/24 production admission values against current queue/fleet telemetry and handle the changelog intentionally.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has recent adjacent capacity-policy history through the exact-review concurrency bound and 128-worker capacity refill changes.
